name: grafana-dashboard-builder
description: Design, generate, preview, and quality-grade Grafana dashboards as code with the Grafana Foundation SDK and Playwright. Includes a rubric-based quality and taste critic.

grafana_url.title: Grafana base URL
grafana_url.description: Base URL of the Grafana instance used to provision and preview dashboards, e.g. http://localhost:3000

grafana_token.title: Grafana API token / service-account token
grafana_token.description: Token with dashboard write access. Used to push generated dashboards via the Grafana HTTP API.

sdk_language.title: Foundation SDK language
sdk_language.description: Preferred Grafana Foundation SDK language for generated projects: typescript, go, or python.

grafana_storage_state.title: Playwright storage-state file (reuse a Chrome/SSO login)
grafana_storage_state.description: Absolute path to a Playwright storageState JSON captured after logging into Grafana (capture-session.sh). Works with OIDC/SSO/SAML: you complete the SSO flow once in a real browser and Playwright reuses that session, so it never has to drive the identity provider.

grafana_cdp_endpoint.title: Chrome CDP endpoint (use a live, SSO-logged-in Chrome)
grafana_cdp_endpoint.description: Connect Playwright to an already-running Chrome instead of launching its own, e.g. http://localhost:9222. Start Chrome with --remote-debugging-port=9222 and a dedicated --user-data-dir, complete the Grafana SSO login there, then set this. Takes precedence over the storage-state file.
